description: Read-only preview of owner-wallet funding to Hyperliquid (crypto) or Derive (options). A quote, including executable:true, does not certify a route for this release: Derive/options funding is under release hold and must not be started. Hyperliquid quotes include provider, expected credit, all-in cost, and estimated duration. This bounded read never creates an operation, intent, fee obligation, or reservation, requests a signature, submits an order, or moves money.

account_id.description: Optional owned child account UUID. Omit for the active account.

amount_usd.description: Owner-wallet funding amount to quote, from $5 through $200.

venue.description: Destination venue. crypto and hyperliquid are equivalent; options and derive are equivalent.

name: preview_funding_route
